name: code-rubric-loose
description: Lightweight code-diagnosis rubric used by the LLM evaluator.

criteria.description: Judge whether the implementation solves the required task behaviorally.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Use objective test outcomes as primary evidence. Do not overclaim correctness when tests fail.

criteria.description: Judge how well the solution handles boundary, null, and unusual cases.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Use failed edge tests, control-flow guards, and input handling as evidence.

criteria.description: Judge whether the chosen approach and complexity are suitable.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Use structure of loops/data structures and complexity-related signals as evidence.

criteria.description: Judge readability, maintainability, and contract adherence.
criteria.evaluation_criteria: Use naming, decomposition, side effects, and contract alignment as evidence.

mistake_patterns: Claims full correctness despite objective test failures.
Rates competencies not in the provided question payload.
